title: Siege of Pizzighettone
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Pizzighettone", at revision 1370744465, opens: "The siege of Pizzighettone was the first major military engagement of the northern Italian campaigns of the War of the Polish Succession." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3625513, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1733 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
